court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Nevada
case_search_note: Online Case Access Portal linked from nevada.courts.ca.gov/online-services/web-portal. Free account required. Publicly searchable: Family, Probate, Civil, Criminal, Traffic; also shows court calendars. Parties can request document access (ID required) and then e-file in their criminal case. Court warns current filings may not appear.

courthouses.name: Nevada City Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's Office Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Hears misdemeanors and felonies, traffic, juvenile justice and dependency. Self-surrender on warrants: misdemeanors Thursdays 1:30 p.m., felonies Fridays 1:30 p.m. — check in at the Criminal Clerk's Office before 11:00 a.m. Self-Help Center & Law Library in the same building (1st floor, Suite 9). Court phone line is the general clerk number (530) 362-4309; no separate criminal number published.
courthouses.todo: Department-by-department criminal assignments not found on court site.

courthouses.name: Truckee Courthouse — Joseph Government Center
courthouses.hours: Clerk's Office Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (court-wide hours)
courthouses.note: Hears misdemeanors and felonies, traffic and juvenile justice. Self-surrender on warrants: Mondays 8:30 a.m., check in at the front counter 8:00–8:30 a.m. Phone shown is the court's general line; no Truckee-specific number published on the Locations page.
courthouses.todo: Truckee-specific phone and department numbers not published.

public_defenders.name: Nevada County Public Defender
public_defenders.note: Represents adults and juveniles charged with crimes. Out-of-custody clients should call or email; people in custody can call the office from the jail for free. Email address is from the office's racial-equity statement on the same page.
public_defenders.todo: No Truckee office or conflict/alternate defender office found on county site.

legal_aid.name: Nevada County Public Defender — Cleaning Up Criminal Records
legal_aid.what: The Public Defender helps with expungement options for Nevada County cases (not other counties or states).

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Auburn office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents of Amador, Calaveras, El Dorado, Nevada, Placer and Sierra counties
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing and public benefits (CalWORKs, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, GA, Social Security/SSI, unemployment, SDI). Does not list criminal defense. Office 190 Reamer Street, Auburn 95603; evening intake message line (866) 815-5990.

legal_aid.name: Nevada County Superior Court Self-Help Center
legal_aid.what: Free legal/procedural info and help with court forms (not legal advice, not confidential). Nevada City walk-in Mon–Thu 8:30–12 & 1:30–4, Fri 8:30–12 (may close 2nd & 4th Wednesdays); Truckee walk-in 2nd & 4th Wednesdays 9–12. Online question form preferred over phone.

probation.name: Nevada County Probation
probation.note: If sentenced to probation, the court instructs you to report in person within 24 hours unless returning to custody. Probation lists a Program Manager for 'Truckee Operations'.
probation.todo: No Truckee probation office address published on the Probation page.

programs.name: Pretrial Risk Assessment (Public Safety Assessment)
programs.summary: Nevada County uses the Public Safety Assessment (PSA) to inform pretrial release decisions (PC 1320.35 disclosure on Probation's page).

programs.name: Adult Drug Court
programs.summary: For select non-violent felony drug-using offenders; minimum 18 months with random testing, intensive probation, bi-weekly court appearances and treatment. Court notes participants who fail may be sentenced to state prison.

programs.name: Adult Mental Health (Behavioral Health) Court
programs.summary: Intensive program for adults and transitional-age youth with mental illness in the justice system: evaluation, treatment and monitoring by a court/law enforcement/probation/mental-health team.

programs.name: DUI Court
programs.summary: Post-adjudication program for people with two DUIs in 5 years or three or more lifetime; enhanced supervision, mandatory treatment, frequent testing and bi-weekly judge reviews. Referred by the court and screened by the DUI Court case manager.

programs.name: Juvenile Drug and Mental Health Court ('YES' Court)
programs.summary: Youth Empowerment Services court addressing alcohol, drug and mental health issues in juveniles.

programs.name: Self-Surrender on Warrants
programs.summary: To clear a Nevada County warrant you must appear: Nevada City misdemeanors Thu 1:30 p.m., felonies Fri 1:30 p.m. (check in before 11 a.m.; both kinds → Friday); Truckee Mondays 8:30 a.m. (check in 8:00–8:30).

jails.name: Wayne Brown Correctional Facility
jails.phone_note: Main county jail; adult-only booking facility housing pre-sentence and sentenced people. Visits are non-contact and by appointment arranged by the incarcerated person (up to four 30-min visits/week; lobby open Tue–Fri). Video visits via GettingOut. Inmate mail goes to a PO Box in Las Vegas (Pigeonly), not the jail.
jails.court_ids_note: nearest, not confirmed — Sheriff says Corrections includes a court holding facility and transportation unit but doesn't name courts.
jails.todo: Sheriff says 'adult-only' but not whether men, women or both — houses left null (it's the only long-term jail, so likely both; not confirmed).

jails.name: Truckee Jail (Truckee Substation)
jails.phone_note: Adult-only booking and temporary holding facility; arrestees from Nevada, Sierra and Placer counties are booked here and held until transported to their county's main jail. No personal visits. Address/phone are the Sheriff's Truckee office from Sheriff media-release letterhead.
jails.todo: Jail street address taken from Sheriff letterhead ('TRUCKEE: 10879 Donner Pass Rd'), not a jail-specific page; men/women housing not stated.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — look up a bail agent's license status. Bail schedules are on the court's Fees & Bail Schedules page (nevada.courts.ca.gov/forms-filing/fees-bail-schedules). No Sheriff page on how/where to post bail was found. Juvenile: Carl F. Bryan II Juvenile Hall closed 1/1/2021 — juvenile arrests/detentions questions go to Juvenile Probation (530) 265-1200.
